description: Look up ingredients Picardo can put in a custom supplement by name, for example "magnesium glycinate", "vitamin D3" or "fish oil". Takes several names at once. Returns each ingredient’s ID for draft_supplement_formula, the unit its amount is measured in, a typical daily amount and the most one daily serving can hold.
name: search_supplement_ingredients

contains.description: What a blend contains; empty for a single ingredient.

maxAmount.description: The most one daily serving can hold.

unit.description: The unit an amount of this ingredient is given in.

title: Search supplement ingredients
